definitions.explanation: A traditional Chinese tea that is partially oxidized, widely consumed in Japan as a cold or hot beverage.

examples.japanese: ウーロン{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧ウーロン{茶|ちゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: In summer, cold oolong tea is delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}めない→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ウーロン{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: People who don't drink alcohol often order oolong tea at izakayas.

notes:
ウーロン{茶|ちゃ} is one of the most popular non-alcoholic drinks in Japan, available at restaurants, convenience stores, and vending machines.

WRITING:
Also written as {烏龍茶|うーろんちゃ} in kanji, but the katakana + kanji form (ウーロン{茶|ちゃ}) is more common.

CULTURAL NOTE:
At ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧ (Japanese pubs), ウーロン{茶|ちゃ} is the standard non-alcoholic option. It is also commonly served free at restaurants as an alternative to water.
